description: Defines the data structures for a Live Activity feature, including the activity attributes and various content states utilized within an iOS app and its widget extension.

classes.name: OpenClawActivityAttributes
classes.description: A structure conforming to ActivityAttributes, representing shared data for a live activity including agent information and session key.

classes.name: OpenClawActivityAttributes.ContentState
classes.description: A nested structure conforming to Codable and Hashable, representing the current state of the activity with status text, flags, and start time.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Provides a static preview instance of OpenClawActivityAttributes for debugging or design purposes.

methods.name: connecting
methods.description: Provides a static ContentState instance indicating a connecting state.

methods.name: idle
methods.description: Provides a static ContentState instance indicating an idle state.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Provides a static ContentState instance indicating a disconnected state.
